name: Club cholla
desc: Club cholla (Grusonia clavata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 45 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Grusonia clavata, the club-cholla, is a species of succulent flowering plant in the genus Grusonia, within the family Cactaceae. It is endemic to central New Mexico, in the southwestern United States.
